<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using bond change criteria that match the Doebner modification: the forward reaction forms a C‑C double bond (bond type 6‑6) and breaks a C‑C single bond and a C‑O single bond (bond types 6‑6 and 6‑8). Using the target product cinnamic acid (SMILES O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1) with these bond criteria should retrieve the relevant template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
